### ✨ New
- ✈️ Airband scanner: a new SDR tool that watches 1.8 MHz of the aviation band, opens every channel that keys up and plays the strongest one in AM; tap a channel to pin it
- 📟 POCSAG: a scan mode finds pagers anywhere in 2 MHz and tells which speed decodes them
- 📻 PMR446: the identities of analogue radios
  - 🆔 Kenwood FleetSync and Motorola MDC-1200 (unit, PTT, emergency, status…)
  - 🎹 5-tone selective calls (ZVEI1, CCIR, EEA) and DTMF strings
- 🎈 Radiosondes: Graw DFM sondes
- 🎧 Listen: a long press on the spectrum puts a notch on a whistle; a volume boost up to +24 dB
- 🔔 Optional sound cues (Settings): a signal found, a lock, a lost lock, a pass ended
- 📸 Spectrum: share a picture of the spectrum and waterfall
- 💡 Advice that shows up only when something is wrong
  - 🎚️ Gain set by hand: too strong, too weak or right
  - 🔌 SDR: samples lost on the USB link, phone not keeping up, frames caught but none decoded, damaged frames
  - ✈️ ADS-B: no aircraft for 2 minutes
  - 📶 Wi-Fi: your channel is crowded while another is free
  - 🐢 DNS: your DNS is much slower than another, or not answering
- 📭 SDR tools say "Ready to listen" before reception starts
- ✨ More motion
  - 📜 List rows rise in, and a new row is marked until you see it or tap it
  - 🔢 Big figures roll when they change
  - 💊 Tabs slide, sections unfold, cards rise in
  - 🗺️ Aircraft, ships and balloons glide to their new position on the maps
  - 🌫️ The page fades out under the bottom bar

### 🐛 Bug fixes
- ✂️ Home in airplane mode: the "Turn on" and "Settings" buttons were cut off
- 🌍 "Dashboard" was in English in every language
- 🔤 After changing the app's language, tool names could stay in the old one
- 🔢 PMR446: the "digital calls" count included analogue signalling
